The dashboard streams, rendering incrementally instead of blocking on the slowest query.
Every API input is validated by a Zod schema, and an invalid payload is rejected before it reaches the database.
The application is deployed and reachable at a live Vercel URL.
A Playwright smoke suite runs in CI and passes on the submitted commit.

title: Database Systems and PostgreSQL Internals
time_commitment: 12 lectures. Each lecture has one main video under 20 minutes and one graded assignment. Optional topic companions are also each under 20 minutes. Budget 5 to 7 hours per week across 8 weeks, roughly 40 hours in total.
prerequisites: Able to write SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE with joins and GROUP BY. This course starts where an introductory SQL course ends.
outcome: Diagnose why a query is slow from its execution plan, fix it with the right index or rewrite, and prove the improvement with numbers.
environment: PostgreSQL 16 or newer in Docker, psql, pgAdmin or DBeaver, the pageinspect and pg stat statements extensions enabled, and a seed dataset of at least one million rows generated on day one.
capstone: A performance case study on a one million row schema. Five slow queries profiled with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, each fixed by indexing, rewriting or partitioning, with before and after timings, plan node evidence, and a written note on the write cost each new index adds.
capstone_criteria: The schema holds at least one million rows, so the timings reflect real work.
Five genuinely slow queries are profiled with EXPLAIN ANALYZE before any change is made.
Each of the five is fixed by indexing, rewriting or partitioning, and the chosen approach is named.
Before and after timings are recorded for every one of the five queries.
Plan node evidence shows what changed in the execution plan, not just the wall clock.
A written note states the write cost that each new index adds.
assessment: 12 assignments at 10 marks each, 120 marks, worth 60 percent. Capstone worth 40 percent. An assignment is marked only when every acceptance criterion passes on the learner's own machine and the evidence listed under submission is attached.
